a. 极端的, 尽头的, 极度的, 偏激的
extreme.d:
n. the furthest or highest degree of something
s. of the greatest possible degree or extent or intensity

extremely.t: adv. 极端地, 非常地

extremism.t: n. 极端倾向, 极端论, 过激主义
extremism.d: n. any political theory favoring immoderate uncompromising policies

extremist.d:
n. a person who holds extreme views
s. (used of opinions and actions) far beyond the norm

extremity.t:
n. 极端, 极点, 困境, 绝境
[医] 肢, 端
extremity.d:
n. an external body part that projects from the body
n. an extreme condition or state (especially of adversity or disease)

extremophile.t: n. “嗜极生物”, 或称作“嗜极菌”, 生活在各种极端恶劣环境下的微生物。

extricate.d: v. release from entanglement of difficulty

extrication.t: n. 救出, 解脱, 游离
extrication.d: n the act of releasing from a snarled or tangled condition

extrinsic.t:
a. 外在的, 外来的, 非国有的, 外表的
[医] 外部的, 体外的
extrinsic.d: a. not forming an essential part of a thing or arising or originating from the outside

extrinsically.t: adv. 非本质地；非固有地

extroversion.t:
n. 外翻, 外倾
[医] 外翻, 外倾
extroversion.d: n (psychology) an extroverted disposition; concern with what is outside the self

extrovert.t:
n. 外向性格的人
[医] 外倾[性格]者
extrovert.d:
n. (psychology) a person concerned more with practical realities than with inner thoughts and feelings
s. being concerned with the social and physical environment

extroverted.t: a. 外向性的；性格外向的；喜社交的
extroverted.d: s. at ease in talking to others

extrude.t:
vt. 挤出, 压出, 逐出
vi. 伸出, 突出
extrude.d: v. form or shape by forcing through an opening

extruded.t: v. 挤压出( extrude的过去式和过去分词 ); 挤压成; 突出; 伸出
extruded.d: v form or shape by forcing through an opening

extruder.t:
n. 挤压机
[化] 挤出机; 压出机

extrusion.t:
n. 挤出, 推出, 赶出
[化] 挤出; 挤塑; 压出
extrusion.d: n. squeezing out by applying pressure

exuberance.t: n. 茂盛, 茂盛的生长物, 丰富
exuberance.d:
n. joyful enthusiasm
n. overflowing with eager enjoyment or approval

exuberant.t:
a. 繁茂的, 丰富的, 生气勃勃的
[医] 生成过多的, 高度增生的
exuberant.d: s. produced or growing in extreme abundance

exuberantly.t: adv. 兴高采烈地, 活跃地, 愉快地

exudate.t:
n. 流出物, 分泌液
[化] 渗出物
exudate.d: n. a substance that oozes out from plant pores

exude.d:
v. release (a liquid) in drops or small quantities
v. make apparent by one's mood or behavior

exult.t: vi. 非常高兴, 欢欣
exult.d: v. feel extreme happiness or elation

exultant.t: a. 非常高兴的, 欢欣的
exultant.d: s. joyful and proud especially because of triumph or success

exultantly.t: adv. 狂欢地, 欢欣鼓舞地

exultation.t: n. 狂喜, 大悦, 欢欣
exultation.d:
n. a feeling of extreme joy
n. the utterance of sounds expressing great joy
